events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the music world lost a hip-hop icon when Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur today. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: Still electrifying generations with his groundbreaking guitar work. Remembering Jimi Hendrix today.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover alone is legendary, let alone the tracks within!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and the album on September 9, 1971 in the US and October 8, 1971 in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. What was the first song you loaded on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the musical genius and peace activist John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His songs still inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! Still making us laugh with his timeless comedy.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: A voice that will never be forgotten. Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost him.

events.title: The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped. An album that changed everything for many, what's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: The music world pauses to remember John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the tragic passing of John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
